title: Oxygen Name
description: The name rule shared by every schema that names an asset or a part of one. A name becomes a segment of a virtual path, so it follows the engine's segment rule (Oxygen/Content/Docs/virtual_paths.md). This definition refuses what a pattern can express; the cooker checks the rest (NFC, unassigned code points, the 255-byte segment bound) and reports the rule's vpath.* code.

segment.description: Not empty; no leading or trailing space; no trailing dot (so not . or ..); not a Windows device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9, with or without an extension); no control characters; none of \ / : * ? " < > |.
